   ui@0.2.0  landed a schema-driven form vocabulary —  ui.Form ,  ui.Field ,  
   ui.Label ,  ui.Select ,  ui.ButtonRow ,  ui.Dialog , and  renderForm  which
  builds a form from a JSON Schema with a per-field override seam.            
                                                                              
  The releases console predates it. Composing a release is a textarea you type
   part-id: ^range  into, one per line, parsed by hand in                     
  src/releases/parse.ts .                                                     
  It works, and it is exactly the thing the form vocabulary exists to replace:
  a                                                                           
  free-text field standing in for a structured input the server already       
  describes.                                                                  
                                                                              
   GET /api/_describe  serves  cdn.compose 's input schema. The console can   
  build                                                                       
  its form from that instead of from a parser.                                
                                                                              
  ## What to do                                                               
                                                                              
  Rebuild the compose form on  renderForm , driven by the descriptor rather   
  than                                                                        
  by a hand-written parser. Parts are a repeating group — id and version range
  —                                                                           
  which is the first real test of whether the vocabulary handles an array of  
  objects, and if it does not, that is a finding worth reporting rather than  
  working around with a textarea.                                             
                                                                              
  Keep what the current console gets right:                                   
                                                                              
  • Dry run before compose. Resolving and reporting problems without writing  
  is the whole reason composing is safe, and it must stay one click away.     
  • Every problem reported at once, not the first one —  cdn.compose  returns 
  them as a list on purpose.                                                  
  •  cx.confirmation.ask  before deploying. Deploying changes what a hostname 
  serves to the internet.                                                     
                                                                              
  If  renderForm  cannot express something the current screen does, say so    
  plainly                                                                     
  in your closing comment. The override seam exists for exactly that, but a   
  seam                                                                        
  used for everything is a seam that is not working.                          
                                                                              
  ## Version discipline                                                       
                                                                              
  Every part that bakes the generated client carries the  shapeHash  it was   
  built                                                                       
  against, and a stale one fails every call with the word "stale". If you     
  regenerate the client, bump  catalog ,  releases ,  auth ,  fleet  and      
  sites                                                                       
  together — this has already bitten twice.                                   
                                                                              
  Browser tests run with  --no-file-parallelism : six files in parallel       
  browsers                                                                    
  hang indefinitely, the same six run serially pass in four seconds.          


FLYBYME (Owner) • 10m • Newest comment

  Plan:                                                                       
                                                                              
  1. Define  COMPOSE_FORM_SCHEMA  in  src/releases/contract.ts  reflecting the
  cdn.compose  input descriptor served by  /api/_describe .

  hand-rolled text parsing from  src/releases/parse.ts .                      
  3. Test  renderForm  against the repeating  parts  array-of-objects group.  
  Because  renderForm  does not natively render repeating item groups (falling
  back to basic text input), use the  overrides.fields.parts.renderControl
